concepts.learning_objective: Find two integers when their sum and difference are given.
Model movements on a number line as integers with magnitude and direction and add them to find a final position.
Use tokens and zero pairs to show that subtracting an integer is the same as adding its additive inverse.
Interpret a product with a positive multiplier as placing tokens into an empty bag repeatedly.
Interpret a product with a negative multiplier as removing tokens, using zero pairs when needed.

topics.title: Patterns, Sign Rules and Commutativity of Multiplication

concepts.learning_objective: State and apply the sign rules for the product of two integers, including Brahmagupta's rules.
Explain that 1 x a = a and (-1) x a = -a for every integer a.
Justify that integer multiplication is commutative, a x b = b x a.

topics.title: Using Integer Multiplication in Real Situations

concepts.learning_objective: Represent marks, profit and loss as integers and compute totals with multiplication and addition.
Represent rising, falling and descending quantities as integers and find the resulting position or value.
Rewrite an integer division as a missing-factor multiplication and solve it.
Apply the sign rules for the quotient of two integers.
Recognise that integer multiplication is associative and that three or more integers can be multiplied in any order.
Find the sign of a product of many integers from the number of negative factors.
Apply the distributive property a x (b + c) = a x b + a x c to integers.
